hypothesis: FACT-style dense continuous value supervision yields action-sensitive validation value estimates, and jointly adapting the small consequence expert can outperform freezing the C38 consequence path without changing H3 or the action generator.
single_variable: Per C38 seed compare joint small-expert training versus freezing the restored C38 consequence modules and training only new future-state/value decoders; data, initialization, batches, losses and optimizer are identical.
parent_baseline: C44 binary linear ranker failed C45/C46 online; C38 consequence mechanism itself was repeated across four seeds and remains the initialization.

data_contract.train: C48 train only, balanced success/failure sampling
data_contract.final: C48 final unread during all C50 arms

validation_gate.selection: lowest validation value MSE among arms passing all mechanism gates; ties favor frozen_consequence

decision.on_pass: Restore selected checkpoint exactly and evaluate C48 final once before any online selector.
decision.on_fail: Do not use dense value online; inspect failure-onset labeling rather than adding steps.
